title: Papoula
desc: A 0-to-1 practice app and brand system for a birth-care professional
role: Product designer and creative director. Discovery, UX, interface, brand system and website. Development was AI-assisted, directed by me.
scope: Mobile app (PWA), brand identity, design system, sales website, course materials
outcome: Live. The founder runs her whole practice in it. More birth professionals join after a month of testing.
lead: Roberta is an obstetric nurse, doula and gestational artist in Brasília. I built her brand, then designed the app she runs her practice on: client files, exams by due date, labor records, payments and postpartum care.

sections.text: Her practice lived in five places that didn't talk to each other. Nothing linked the due date to the exams, the payments or the messages.
Real client conversations, a benchmark of practice apps and sessions with her on how a week actually runs. One user, phone only, often with one free hand, between shifts and births.
Four phases. In each one the app calculates and reminds; she decides and sends.
Five destinations in a bottom bar. Everything about one client lives in one file.
From a new client to her first reminder. One flow replaces the spreadsheet, the contract file, the payment notes and the exam calendar.
Repeated across the app: the system prepares, the person acts. Nothing is sent without her.
Brand red only for actions and status. Large numbers, 44 px touch targets, one primary action per screen.
She ran her real client list from the first version. What broke became a change, usually shipped the same day.
Health data, handled like health data, at zero hosting cost. The app records and reminds; clinical decisions stay with the nurse.
A watercolor poppy that bleeds off the edge, four colors in a fixed ratio and two typefaces. The same tokens run the app, the site and the course.
The sales page opens with the objection students voice most, “I can't draw”, and answers it section by section. Scroll inside the frame.
Class decks, a conference talk and the brand manual that keeps every new piece on system.
